criteria.description: The generator builds the whole package into opendesign/spec-kitty-train/; USAGE.md and DESIGN.md's prose are authored and prose-checked (FR amended)
criteria.evidence: scripts/build-opendesign-package.mjs buildPackage(); `node scripts/build-opendesign-package.mjs --check` → current: 34 components, 157 static forms
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: components.html and every components/<name>.html are static-only

criteria.description: Every component with a static form is covered with every static form, derived from the tree
